rachel_cs: Quick heads up  small set of EU onboarding customers saw prolonged retries and occasional 502s 2026-03-25 12:15-12:40 UTC. Affected tenants: T-7001, T-7004, T-7010.

ben_support: Noticed spike at 12:16, initiated failover to standby at 12:22, error rate dropped ~75% but a few onboarding jobs still stuck.

omar_eng: Root cause summary: under certain multi-file ingest payloads, the batching scheduler hit an edge case that caused backpressure and worker churn. We applied a temporary throttle (max_batches=5) and restarted workers at 12:27. Patch in review, ETA ~3h.

rachel_cs: Draft customer note below  concise and empathetic. Please flag any edits.

rachel_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,

Were reaching out about a transient issue in EU Dedicated that affected onboarding between 12:1512:40 UTC on Mar 25. You may have seen longer completion times or intermittent 502 responses.

What we did: routed traffic to a standby pool, restarted affected workers, and applied temporary throttles to stabilize throughput.

Offer: we can re-run any stalled onboarding batches for you, schedule a 30-minute remediation session with an integration engineer, and apply a one-time billing credit to offset retry-related compute.

Self-help: if youd like to speed up completion while we finish the fix, temporarily reduce `batch_size` to 4 and add `retry_backoff` ~250ms, or enable Region Failover in Console > Deployments. If you require strict EU-only handling, reply and well coordinate a non-cross-region remediation.

Next steps: we will publish a full RCA within 48h after verification of the fix.

Thanks,
Rachel on behalf of Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

linda_billing: Legal approved credit wording: "A one-time credit equal to estimated retry compute during the impacted window will be applied to your next invoice. Contact us for a custom review."

incident_bot: Incident logged: 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-EdgeCase (P2). Lead: omar_eng.

ben_support: Scheduling office hours Wed/Thu 14:00-16:00 UTC; will attach diagnostics checklist and invite contacts.

rachel_cs: Sending localized EN/FR/DE copies and tagging renewals for T-7010 as high-touch (extended retries). I'll paste sent recipients and confirm credits applied here after send. Thanks all :pray:
